description: React component for uploading CSV files in an onboarding organization invite modal, including template download, file validation, and invite parsing.

classes.name: OrganizationCSVUploadModal
classes.description: React functional component for CSV upload modal with file handling, template download, and onboarding invite processing.

methods.name: handleFileSelect
methods.description: Handles file selection, validates CSV extension, and updates state.

methods.name: handleDownloadTemplate
methods.description: Generates and triggers download of a CSV template with headers and example row.

methods.name: handleUpload
methods.description: Processes the selected CSV file, parses invites, updates store, and navigates to email invite page.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets file input and closes the modal.
